title: The "Viral" Oreo Cake
ingredients: 30 Oreo cookies (cream filling separated and reserved for icing)
1 cup milk (plus a small extra splash for the icing)
instructions: Twist apart the Oreos and scrape off the cream filling; set the filling aside in a separate bowl — this becomes the icing base.
Crush the cookie wafers into fine crumbs (food processor or rolling pin).
Mix the cookie crumbs with 1 cup milk and 1 Tbsp baking powder until you have a smooth batter.
Pour the batter into a greased pan (a Bundt pan works well, especially if doubling the recipe) or individual mugs.
Bake until set, or microwave individual portions — both methods were confirmed by commenters, but exact time/temperature was not stated in the source video.
For the icing, stir a dash of milk into the reserved Oreo cream filling until smooth, then spread over the cooled cake.
notes: Source is a Facebook reel by Darcy Mays (Mamma May's Kitchen) captioned 'VIRAL OREO-CAKE — ONLY TAKES 3-INGREDIENTS'. The on-screen ingredient list (30 Oreos, 1 cup milk, 1 Tbsp baking powder) was confirmed by the author replying directly to a commenter who asked. Exact bake time/temperature is not given anywhere in the caption or comments (the author told a commenter the recipe is just the on-screen text). Method steps above are reconstructed from commenter tips: one person doubled the recipe into a Bundt cake, another microwaves individual portions and scrapes/melts the cream filling with milk for icing, another suggests sprinkling the pan with sugar or dusting with cocoa powder instead of flour. Treat bake time/temp as an estimate until tested.
